invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null List due to Stream.collect; collect(Collectors.toList()) never returns null.
All elements produced by fg.getFileId() are file IDs, which are expected to be non-null; Stream.map and file ID extraction for valid slices should not yield nulls.
The stream applies 'distinct()', so there are no duplicate file IDs in the result.
partitionPath is passed to getLatestFileSlices, which presumably does not allow null, and is typically required for identifying a partition.
